verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability's docs say users can visualize their metrics and use prebuilt dashboards to diagnose issues, so a first-party dashboard and visualization capability exists. Nothing in the pack shows that SREs can build custom dashboards, share them, choose from rich visualization types, or use template variables. missing for 10: evidence of user-built custom dashboards, dashboard sharing, a catalog of visualization types, template variables/controls, dashboards-as-code export, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL), visualize them
